title: Best Models and Actors for Hire Online (2026): Content and Ads
description: How to hire models or actors for product photos, videos, ads or voice-free performances: usage rights, releases, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Freelance models and actors appear in product photos, social media content, ads, explainer videos and short films. Many record from home studios, while others work on location. Good talent brings your product or story to life and matches your audience. Projects go wrong when usage rights are unclear, there is no signed release, or the brief does not explain the scene, wardrobe and tone. This guide helps you hire talent professionally and fairly.

faq.q: Do I need a model release?
faq.a: Yes, for commercial use. It confirms permission to use the person's image and voice.

faq.q: How long can I use the content?
faq.a: Agree on usage duration, platforms and regions. Ads usually need broader rights.
Agree in advance. Some talent bring their own; products are usually shipped by you.
